      <div class="wrap">
        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">5</span><p class="sp-r">Titlacaqui sums to 41, which reduces to 5: change, a knock at the door and a heart pounding.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XX Le Jugement (Judgement)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Jugement is a call that is heard; the song knocks and asks if anyone is listening.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVI La Maison Dieu (The Tower)</span><p class="sp-r">La Maison Dieu is struck open by a ray from above; the gap in the door tears wider and light comes in.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">I Le Bateleur (The Magician)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Bateleur is the first card, the day starting and every tool waking on the table.</p></div>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">6</span><p class="sp-r">Ximolini sums to 51, which reduces to 6: love, sway with me, I am yours.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">VI L&#x27;Amoureux (The Lover)</span><p class="sp-r">L&#x27;Amoureux stands between two loves; the song holds the other in its arms at night.</p></div>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">5</span><p class="sp-r">She Dances the Sun Down sums to 77, which reduces to 5: change, the day turning into night.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVIIII Le Soleil (The Sun)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Soleil is the light she dances down until the sun disc is hidden.</p></div>

        <div class="ms-paperwrap"><article class="ms-letter lyr-sheet"><span class="ms-age" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-edge" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-a" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-burn burn-b" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-frame" aria-hidden="true"><i class="tl"></i><i class="tr"></i><i class="bl"></i><i class="br"></i></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-1" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-2" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-blood ms-blood-3" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drip drip-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-l" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-r" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-t" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-c" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-spat sp-f" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-drop" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="ms-seal" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="ms-kicker ly-kicker">Lyrics</p><h2 class="ms-title ly-title">The Ninth Night</h2><p class="ly-sub">Track IX of X &middot; from <span class="ly-alb">She Who Stays</span></p><div class="ms-rule" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="ly-book"><div class="ly-heads"><p class="ly-h">As sung <span class="ly-ph">(phonetic)</span></p><p class="ly-h ly-h-t">In English</p></div><p class="ly-phnote">The old words are written here as they are sung, sound by sound. The English is on the right.</p><div class="ly-body"><div class="ly-sec"><p class="ly-label">Intro</p><p class="ly-label ly-label-t" aria-hidden="true">Intro</p></div><div class="ly-orn"         <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">11</span><p class="sp-r">The Last Door sums to 47, which reduces to 11, a master number kept as it is: illumination at the last door.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XXI Le Monde (The World)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Monde closes the cycle; the doors open each by itself and she enters.</p></div>
        </aside>

        <aside class="sign-plates" aria-label="The signs of this song">
          <div class="sign-plate sp-num"><span class="sp-k">Number</span><span class="sp-v">8</span><p class="sp-r">One to Wake From sums to 62, which reduces to 8: power, the strength to reach the dawn.</p></div>
          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XVIIII Le Soleil (The Sun)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Soleil rises over two children: a sleep to wake from, safe and sound.</p></div>
        </aside>

          <div class="sign-plate sp-card"><span class="sp-k">Marseille card</span><span class="sp-v sp-v-card">XX Le Jugement (Judgement)</span><p class="sp-r">Le Jugement calls him up out of the dirt; past the last iron, then her.</p></div>
